title: About
intro: I lead data and AI work at {company}, teach at BITS Pilani and run {communities} tech communities.
bio: I'm {role} at {company}. I set the data and AI direction for our clients and build the platforms behind it.

Over {years}+ years in travel, banking, finance and e-commerce, I've shipped BI, data pipelines, machine learning, LLM apps and real-time systems on Microsoft Fabric, Azure and Databricks. I like owning a problem from the first conversation to the version running in production.
I did my M.Tech at BITS Pilani and now teach Data Visualisation, Machine Learning and NLP there as Guest Faculty. I'm certified in {certifications}.
I'm a Tableau Ambassador (2025 and 2026), and I run {communities} data and AI communities for Tableau, AWS, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and IBM users.
How I work: understand the problem properly, build only what solves it, and keep the engineering simple.
